purpose: Small independent falsification of integer primitive lemma-to-C correspondence; not a full estimator or endurance proof.

attenuation.critical_ratios: Zero, tiny, unity, range-reduction boundaries, near32, and q>=32; all num/den within uint32.
attenuation.oracle: Exact Fraction positive Taylor sum for exp(q), geometric-tail upper bound after decreasing terms, inversion. Stop when reciprocal enclosure width<=2^-160; at most512 terms. For q>=32 use analytic exp(-q)<2^-32. C interval must contain whole rational oracle interval.
attenuation.note: Independent from C alternating polynomial and reduction/squaring. The sampled audit corroborates the analytic all-input proof; it is not an exhaustive uint32 sweep.

state.critical_cases: Zero/max domain, negative floor/ceil, exact unity/zero attenuation, full coefficient uncertainty and endpoints.
state.oracle: Independent Fraction convex expression at bilinear corners plus interior points; exact outward integer endpoints and physical-domain containment.

charge.critical_cases: Extreme signed-code/unsigned-tick products; INT64 boundaries; admitted-prefix rejects; exact cycling; negative return leaves object unchanged.
charge.oracle: Python unbounded integer product and sum with explicit representable/admitted interval predicates.

mask.oracle: Python set intersection, exact duplicate/uninformative retention and explicit empty inconsistency.
mask.demo: Eight cells: informative certificates, quiet identities, renewed refinement. Constructed certificates, no battery-certificate soundness claim.
mask.negative_control: Overlapping cells [0,2] and [1,3], true parameter3/2, certificates keeping different single cells each cover truth by union but intersect empty. Expected inconsistency refutes weak union-cover premise, not kernel arithmetic.

nominal_stream.oracle: Sound rational exp(-actual_dt/tau) enclosures and independent rational state interval transport, outward quantized only onto a 2^-128 oracle grid to bound audit cost.
nominal_stream.scope: Illustrative arithmetic grid, not a claim about ADC hardware, calibrated current, physical parameters or frozen benchmark trace.
nominal_stream.width_bound: Report exact rational (2B*h+2D)/g for active updates, h=max(A_upper-A_lower), g=min(D-A_upper)>0; zero-time exact identities excluded from contraction. This is conditional arithmetic width, not physical accuracy.

output_policy: Refuse an existing receipt. Preserve failures. Primary receipt only after source/plan commit. Record commands, platform, exact source revision and source/binary hashes. No production algorithm replacement.
nonclaims: Parameter drift or chart transition support
